runtime.precision: float32 compute; weights stored as BF16 in the checkpoint and upcast exactly to float32 on load

hooks.blocks: output of model.model.layers[i] (residual stream after the block)
hooks.attention: second output of model.model.layers[i].self_attn (eager softmax probabilities) for blocks [0, 13, 27], heads [0, 1, 8, 15]
hooks.gate: SiLU(x @ mlp.gate_proj.weight.T) recomputed from the hooked MLP input, blocks [0, 13, 27], first 32 channels

note: Real activations of Qwen3-0.6B for the prompts below. Qwen3-0.6B is a smaller model of the same Qwen3 dense family; these are NOT activations of Qwen3-8B or Qwen3-30B-A3B.
